about: The air and what floats in it (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Air and lift'). 'scaleHeight': metres over which the air thins by e above 'seaLevel'. 'lift': kg a cubic metre at sea level, per gas ('hotAir' at a full cell's heat). 'gasLitresPerM3': litres of a tank's compressed gas that fill a cubic metre of cell. Soft lift, the kinder scale of big builds: a construct's lift counts (cell volume / softFromM3) ^ softPower times over, from softFromM3 up, at most softMost. 'leakSpeed': m/s gas leaves through a hole. 'holePerDamage': m2 of hole a point of damage makes, at most 'holeMost' m2 a hit and 'holeCell' m2 a cell; a hit of 'igniteDamage' or more lights hydrogen. 'coolShare', 'ventShare', 'ventHotShare', 'pumpShare', 'burnShare': shares of a cell a second. 'drag': the cell's drag coefficient, acting 'dragArm' of the way from the centre of mass to the centre of lift. 'spinDrag': how fast air stops a balloon's turning, a second at sea level. 'turbulence': m/s2 of shake for each m/s of wind. 'windAloftAt': metres up where the cloud-level wind has taken over. 'nearMetres': cells this close to a player are simulated one by one; further off, lift is one summed force. 'groundEffect' and 'groundEffectSpans': lift a wing gains at the ground, and how many spans up it fades. 'softWingM2': past this much wing a craft's lift counts (area / softWingM2) ^ softPower times over, at most softMost. 'bodyDrag': Cd A of a flying craft's body, m2 per kg^(2/3). 'flightTop': the most a craft flying on its surfaces goes, m/s. 'rotorProfile': the share of a rotor's power that turns it and pushes nothing; 'rotorFigure': how well the rest pushes; 'rotorHit': the share of a spinning disc in which a round meets a blade; 'rotorShake': a lost blade's shake, as a share of the push. 'bladeStyles': what a rotor's blades can be, in the order of its Blade style choices (add at the end): 'push', 'power' and 'top' are shares of the rotor's own thrust, power taken and top speed, 'stations' four rows root to tip of [width over the chord, offset off the radius over the radius].
